Context: 4. Absorption in ABs/PSUs, etc.

1. Deemed Retirement/Resignation.Such an employee is deemed to have retired/ resigned from service from the date of such absorption. For service in the Government, they would be eligible for Service Gratuity/ Pension and Retirement Gratuity admissible under relevant rules.  
2. Retirement Benefits.Monthly pension and retirement gratuity on the basis of qualifying service up to the date of permanent absorption will be admissible.
